title: tc-image-grid
description: Generated images as a grid of variations: regenerate one, upscale, compare two, download, alt text for each.

prompt.description: The prompt the images came from, shown under the heading

columns.description: Tiles per row (fewer when there are fewer tiles)

actions.description: Which actions a done tile offers

compare.description: The two tile ids side by side, or null for the grid

split.description: Where the compare divider is: 0–100, percent from the left

openable.description: Done tiles open: clicking the image, or Space or O on the tile, fires tc-open (for a viewer or a detail pane)

fill.description: Grow to the container's width instead of stopping at 560px

src.description: The image URL – a data: URL works too. Shown when the tile is done

alt.description: What the image shows, for people who can't see it. Required – an empty string shows "Add alt text"

progress.description: 0 to 1 while pending; left out, the tile just shimmers

activity.description: What a pending tile says it is doing – "Generating" by default ("Upscaling", "Varying"…)

upscaled.description: Marks an upscaled image: a badge, and Upscale is off

filename.description: File name for downloads – from the heading and the tile number by default

badge.description: A short status pill in the tile's top-left corner – "Attested", "Unverified", "Draft"

meta.description: A short note beside the tile number – "3 claims", "×2"

ImageGridBadgeTone.description: The colours a tile badge can take
